title: fix(drilling): include drill point length in through holes, stock sim, and MCP
body:
## Breaking project-format change

Saved projects now use v68, previously v67. Readers limited to v67 or earlier refuse v68 files instead of dropping `break_through_from` and changing drilling depths. This build migrates older files while preserving legacy `Tip` behavior. Commit `f1bbbee614d5ec580c60e173cb838af5b2288ff8` declares this incompatibility with `!` and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer.

## Levels controls before and after

These captures render the real egui shell with the same Drill Heights page and Levels controls. The viewport uses the test harness placeholder. The before capture uses the pre-feature Levels UI; the after capture shows the new `Break-through from` selector set to `Full diameter`. Images live only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: Levels without the selector](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0920bf8e0d4387421b08d8b187fafab03366ea18/2504/before-levels.png) | ![After: Levels with Break-through from](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0920bf8e0d4387421b08d8b187fafab03366ea18/2504/after-levels.png) |

## Review-fix verification

Head: `f1bbbee614d5ec580c60e173cb838af5b2288ff8`.

- Selector pin `drill_break_through_from_defaults_to_full_diameter_and_switches_to_tip`: RED with the pre-feature selector removed, GREEN after restoration.
- Extended format pin `v65_preserves_cutting_steps_and_loads_v63_break_through_and_v62_defaults`: RED with the saved version changed to v67, GREEN after restoring v68. `wrong_version_is_refused` also passed.
- PR-body check: original body failed the screenshot-link check; updated remote body passed both immutable image links and the reader-limit check.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 589/592 steps passed in 35.6 minutes. The failures were the previously recorded `microarc_test_part::a_wrapped_op_on_the_test_part_posts_wrapped_a` (3246 != 3245), `stock_source_holes::framed_stock_chamfer_live_refusal_keeps_hint_without_local_move_number`, and the review's `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` (no graphics adapter). Both review-fix pins passed in this run.
- Strict Clippy for all targets of `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-sim`, `camcraft-app`, and `camcraft-ui` failed on the review's unchanged `crates/app/src/operation/heights.rs:128` warning. The same command passed with only `clippy::needless_borrows_for_generic_args` allowed.

## What changed

- Added `BreakThroughFrom` (`FullDiameter` by default, or `Tip`) to `Drill` parameters, UI (`Break-through from` combo in `holes_page.rs`), MCP DTOs, and project v68 (`PROJECT_VERSION = 68`).
- Added `drill_point_length` and `through_tip_run` in `camcraft_motion::drilling`. In `FullDiameter` mode on twist drills outside `Spot`, `Tap`, `FloatingTap`, and `Ream`, `through_tip_run` adds `(diameter / 2) / tan(tip_angle / 2)` (`180 deg -> 0.0`). Non-finite or out-of-range tip angles fail by name. Lathe axial drills keep `Tip` mode for `axial_doors` clearance.
- Migrated pre-v68 projects without `break_through_from` to `Tip` in `settle_drill_break_through`. Existing saved files keep their cached depths and posted Z.
- Added `SdfTool::Drill` and `RevKind::Drill` (`drill_dist`) in `camcraft_sim::stock_sim`, plus `simulate_drill` and `simulate_drill_display` across plain, display, carried, held, playback, field-view, and rest simulation.
- Listed `break_through` (`number`, default `null`) on `drill`, `bore`, and `thread` in `list_operation_types` (`crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs`).

## Cause

Through holes with a twist drill added only `break_through` (`1.0 mm` default) to the tip depth, stopping the cylindrical margin ~0.803 mm short on a Ø6 118° drill. Both column and field stock simulation also modeled drills as flat cylinders at full diameter, hiding the uncut cone lip. Separately, `kind_defaults()` skipped `None` fields on serialization, so `list_operation_types` omitted `break_through`.

## Tests

### Pins (red before fix, green after)
- `issue_2441_through_hole_drill_adds_point_length_and_posts_full_breakthrough` (`crates/app/tests/break_through.rs`): failed before fix (`deepest tip must include the 118 deg drill point (-2.803), got -1.000`), passes after fix (posts `Z-19.803` and clears both sims at `r=2.5`).
- `issue_2441_stock_sim_models_drill_point_cone_lip_when_stopped_at_floor` (`crates/app/tests/break_through.rs`): failed before fix (`got z=0.000` flat bottom), passes after fix (leaves `~1.5 mm` cone lip at `r=2.5` in both sims when tip stops at `z=0`).
- `issue_2441_mcp_list_operation_types_lists_break_through` (`crates/app/tests/break_through.rs`): failed before fix (`drill is missing break_through`), passes after fix for `drill`, `bore`, `thread`, and `break_through_from`.
- `issue_2441_mcp_can_patch_break_through_and_break_through_from`, `drill_point_length_respects_tip_angle_and_refuses_bad_angles`, `through_exit_clears_the_floor`, `drill_engines_cut_cone_with_cylindrical_flute_and_agree`, `drill_break_through_from_defaults_to_full_diameter_and_switches_to_tip`: all pass.

### Mutation checks
- `crates/motion/src/drilling/cycle.rs` (`through_tip_run` reverted to `p.through_clear`): `issue_2441_through_hole_drill_adds_point_length_and_posts_full_breakthrough` failed RED -> restored GREEN.
- `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs` (`ToolKind::Drill` cone & `drill` flag reverted to `(None, false)`): `issue_2441_stock_sim_models_drill_point_cone_lip_when_stopped_at_floor` failed RED -> restored GREEN.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs` (`break_through` injection removed in `list_operation_types`): `issue_2441_mcp_list_operation_types_lists_break_through` failed RED -> restored GREEN.
- `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs` (`settle_drill_break_through` skipped for `from < 68`): `v65_preserves_cutting_steps_and_loads_v63_break_through_and_v62_defaults` failed RED -> restored GREEN.

### Gate and Clippy
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean (`exit 0`).
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (at `5485b6476`): 589/592 steps passed in 78.2 minutes. All `sim` (41/41), `motion` (5/5), and `ui` (9/9) steps passed. Three `camcraft-app` suites reported failures:
  - `shoulder_adaptive` (`containment_outside_clears_past_the_edge_never_the_recess` hit its 60 s debug timer under 6-way contention, tracked by #2453): re-running `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test shoulder_adaptive -- --test-threads=1` passed 9/9 (69.42s).
  - `microarc_test_part` (`a_wrapped_op_on_the_test_part_posts_wrapped_a`, `3246 != 3245` lines): pre-existing failure on `upstream/main` tracked by #2483 and reproduced in `upstream/main` post-merge CI run `44279917425`.
  - `stock_source_holes` (`framed_stock_chamfer_live_refusal_keeps_hint_without_local_move_number`): pre-existing failure on `upstream/main` since `7bcc13a4b` and reproduced in `upstream/main` post-merge CI run `44279917425`.
- Targeted suites observed inside the `5485b6476` gate run: `break_through` (12/12), `operations` (120/120, 6 ignored), `first_router_part` (4/4), `example_catalog` (2/2), `mcp` (22/22), `golden_cl` (33/33), `solid_law_goldens` (7/7).

## Goldens moved

- No `.cl` goldens changed (`git diff --stat upstream/main...HEAD -- "*.cl"` is empty).
- `examples/catalog/2d/first-part/first-part.nc` (plus `first-part.camproj` and `README.md`): only the four `Drill1` (`DR-0600`) cycles moved (`G73 X... Y... Z-1. R22. Q18. F300` -> `G83 X... Y... Z-2.803 R22. Q6. F300`), as adding the `1.803 mm` point crosses the `4d` (`24 mm`) `Auto` depth threshold into `G83`.
- `examples/first-router-part.camproj` (plus `site/content/guide/getting-started/first-router-part.md`): regenerated `Drill1` moves and cycle `bottom_z` from `-1.0` to `-2.802582` (`G73 ... Z-14.803` in `G54`); `2D Pocket1` and `2D Contour1` paths are unchanged.

## Not exercised

- Interactive GPU viewport rendering was not run; field and column drill cones were checked numerically in unit tests and `stock_view::field_view`.
- Radial cross drilling (`cross_drill`) keeps its own existing through math and does not read `break_through_from`.
- The full `release` tier (with `--ignored` heavy lanes and Windows UI pixel snapshots) was not run.

## Overlaps

Touches the same file (different functions/arms or regenerated assets; whichever merges second refreshes):
- #2503 (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` 2D extension / keep-law arm)
- #2488 (`crates/app/src/project/apply.rs` `freeze_legacy_tool_numbers`, `crates/app/src/project/file.rs` `ToolDto`)
- #2486 (`examples/first-router-part.camproj`)
- #2460 (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` 2D Contour arms)
- #2253 (`crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs`, `generate.rs`, `project/file.rs` `PROJECT_VERSION`, `project/apply.rs`, `crates/app/tests/units_in_refusals.rs`; already has `conflicts`)
- #2149 (`crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs`, `generate.rs`, `project/file.rs`, `project/apply.rs`; already has `conflicts`)
- #2134 (`crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs`, `project/file.rs`, `project/apply.rs`, `crates/app/tests/break_through.rs`; already has `conflicts`)
- #2092 (`crates/app/src/project/file.rs`, `project/apply.rs`, `crates/app/tests/break_through.rs`)
- #2024 (`crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`)
- #1713 (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` Finish3D arms, `kinds.rs`, `project/params.rs`, `project/params_impl.rs`, `crates/app/tests/golden_cl.rs`, `crates/app/tests/operations.rs`, `crates/motion/tests/center_cut_owed.rs`)

Changelog: Include drill point length in through-hole break-through by default (`Full diameter` vs `Tip`), simulate twist-drill cones accurately, and expose `break_through` in MCP `list_operation_types`.

Fixes #2441
